item.description:
I'm looking for the album Sonder (Apple Music Edition) that's found here and the album Sonder (2023 Reissue) that's found here. I'm looking for all 12 of the original album tracks, 11 of which are on the Apple Music Edition and all 12 are on the 2023 Reissue. The Apple Music Edition is missing track 8 Don't Forget Me that's on the Reissue, but the Apple Music Edition has two live Apple Music Edition tracks [12 Something to Someone (Apple Music Edition) and 13 Better Days (Apple Music Edition)].

I'm hoping to get all 14 tracks in Dolby Atmos, it doesn't matter which albums they come from. There also 3 videos with the album, if you can get them too that woud be a cool bonus, but I'm mostly looking for the Atmos files. Any help would be appreciated.
